description: This Java class 'SensorSnifferPane' provides a graphical user interface component for visualizing sensor data in real-time. It displays an interactive panel with controls to pause/clear data, save graphs as images, and configure sensor modes and thresholds. It subscribes to sensor data updates, processes the data, and paints a real-time chart of sensor values.

classes.name: SensorSnifferPane
classes.description: A GUI component for sensor data visualization with controls for manipulation, leveraging swing components and custom UI elements.

classes.name: SensorSnifferCanvas
